name: Sentrook OpenClaw
description: Sentrook trajectory scanner (hosted HTTPS or local URL). Scans tool calls and can allow, require human approval, or block flagged actions.

url.description: Sentrook scan service base URL (e.g. http://sentrook-scan:9099 or https://sentrook.example). Falls back to SENTROOK_SCAN_URL env, then http://sentrook-scan:9099.

apiKey.description: Shared scan API key (optional override). Preferred: SENTROOK_SCAN_API_KEY in ~/.openclaw/.env — do not use SecretRefs here (unresolved refs fail-close the gateway).

clientId.description: Optional override. Preferred: SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_ID in ~/.openclaw/.env (or compose env_file).

clientSecret.description: Optional override. Preferred: SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_SECRET in ~/.openclaw/.env — avoid SecretRefs in openclaw.json (unresolved refs fail-close the gateway).

oidcIssuer.description: OIDC issuer base URL. Default https://identity.firstdataunion.org. Env: SENTROOK_OIDC_ISSUER.

oidcAudience.description: Expected token audience. Default sentrook. Env: SENTROOK_OIDC_AUDIENCE.

oidcScope.description: OAuth scope requested for scan tokens. Default sentrook.scan. Env: SENTROOK_OIDC_SCOPE.

timeoutMs.description: Scan request timeout in ms. Gates the agent while awaiting /scan. Default 1500 for local HTTP, 3000 for HTTPS (or SENTROOK_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS).

onScanError.description: When /scan times out, cannot connect, returns 5xx, or is rate-limited after retry. allow = continue without scanning (default for existing installs). deny = block the tool. review = ask (interactive); unattended uses approval.scheduledTimeoutBehavior immediately. Env: SENTROOK_ON_SCAN_ERROR.

mode.description: Feedback for review resolutions (allow-once / deny). off = disabled. submit = POST sanitized candidates to hosted Sentrook /feedback (forwarded to Rookery). Configure wizard defaults to submit (community corpus contribution); opt out with feedback.mode=off or --contribute-corpus false.

approval.description: Human approval timeouts for review decisions. Unattended cron/subagent runs get a longer window; both interactive and scheduled reviews default to deny-on-timeout (fail-closed).

interactiveTimeoutMs.description: Review timeout for interactive sessions (ms). Default 300000 (5 min). Env: SENTROOK_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS.

scheduledTimeoutMs.description: Review timeout for unattended cron/subagent runs (ms). Default 1800000 (30 min). Env: SENTROOK_SCHEDULED_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS.

scheduledTimeoutBehavior.description: When an unattended review times out. Default deny (fail-closed). Set allow if cron/subagent jobs must proceed without a human. Env: SENTROOK_SCHEDULED_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_BEHAVIOR.

scheduledIntentKinds.description: Intent kinds that use the scheduled policy. Default [cron, subagent].

allowlist.description: Local short-circuit for allow-always decisions. Stores skeletons / script content hashes under ~/.openclaw; does not override Sentrook blocks.

enabled.description: When true (default), allow-always records a local entry and matching future reviews skip requireApproval. Env: SENTROOK_ALLOWLIST_ENABLED.

path.description: Override path for sentrook-allowlist.json. Default ~/.openclaw/sentrook-allowlist.json (or $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/...). Env: SENTROOK_ALLOWLIST_PATH.

scriptBind.description: When true (default), interpreter+local-script forms are stored as path+SHA-256 bindings. Env: SENTROOK_ALLOWLIST_SCRIPT_BIND.
